# ===== BUSINESS OVERVIEW =====

Description: MainTech Appliance Repairs is an appliance, air conditioning, and refrigeration repair business serving homes and businesses across Gauteng, South Africa. We handle everything from a fridge that has stopped cooling to full air conditioning installation and commercial cold room work, with one trusted team you only need to call once.

Response Time: Call 065 650 8504 to arrange a visit across Gauteng
Emergency Support: weekday hours for cooling and refrigeration breakdowns

Mission: Keep homes and businesses across Gauteng cool and running with fast, honest, professional repairs and reliable service.
